Build integrations against the supported document model

The metadata explorer makes folder, file, file-content and role relationships discoverable. Consumers can generate or design clients from the public API shape without depending on the domain's persistence implementation.

This is the quickest reference when an integration needs to navigate documents, upload content or understand the available query surface.
